image_description: A side-profile view of a small rabbit, likely a cottontail or wood rabbit, sitting on dry ground near a large rock and some evergreen foliage. The rabbit has greyish-brown fur, long upright ears, and is facing left. Its hind legs are tucked beneath its body, and the short tail is visible at the rear.
